description: This PHP source file defines the I18nPluginConfiguration class, which implements plugin configuration initialization for an internationalization (i18n) plugin within the OrangeHRM system. It registers I18NService and I18NHelper services into a dependency container.

classes.name: I18nPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Implements plugin configuration interface for initializing internationalization services in the OrangeHRM plugin system.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Registers I18NService and I18NHelper services into the dependency injection container during plugin initialization.
